newsitem.title: USA: Hayes Micro to consolidate domestic operations.
newsitem.headline: Hayes Micro to consolidate domestic operations.

text.p: Hayes Microcomputer Products Inc said Friday it would consolidate its domestic manufacturing operations at its Norcross, Georgia, headquarters and end its operations in Thousand Oaks, California, in an effort to improve its competitiveness.
"For Hayes to continue to improve its position in this industry, it must continue to focus on improving efficiency in all areas ... especially manufacturing," it said.
The company, which makes analog modems, said closing down its Thousand Oaks facility will force it to incur a one-time restructuring charge of $6.5 million in the fourth quarter of 1996.
It said it expected the move to save it $5 million to $6 million in manufacturing overhead costs a year.

The shutdown, which begins September 13 and ends in March 1997, will affect 350 to 375 jobs related to manufacturing, it said, adding that an engineering group and its multi-media products business unit will continue to operate at the Thousand Oaks location.
